```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Install required libraries at the beginning of the document
# - assume tidyverse (which includes ggplot2, dplyr, etc.) is already installed
# - also assume pagedown or other rmarkdown theme libraries are installed
# Ex) installing ggtext; provide the repo to avoid interruption
install.packages("ggtext", repos = "https://packagemanager.posit.co/cran/latest")
library(tidyverse)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```


## Read from the same directory

_Below code reads the `ont-sa-characteristic-ow-ont.csv` file uploaded in the
same directory as the R Markdown file. You must also submit the data file with
the submission._

```{r data_local}
df <- read_csv("ont-sa-characteristic-ow-ont.csv")
df |>
  mutate(yearmonth = as.Date(paste0(year, "-", month, "-01"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearmonth, y = cases)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(150000, 300000))
```


## Read from online (e.g., GitHub)

_Below code reads the `ont-school-demo-info.csv` file from my GitHub repo. You
must ensure the URL is public._


```{r data_github, out.width="100%", fig.asp=1}
df <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjmoon/sta313-project-datasets/refs/heads/main/ONT-SCHOOL/ont-school-demo-info.csv")
df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = longitude, y = latitude)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(vars(year)) +
  theme_void()
```
